note: Rejudged independently against RFC 4724 Section 4.1: "To re-establish the session with its peer, the Restarting Speaker MUST set the "Restart State" bit in the Graceful Restart Capability of the OPEN message." TestRFC4724OpenInsideTheRestartWindowSetsRestartState supplies a future restart deadline and a plugin code-64 value with R clear, builds and parses OPEN, and asserts R set, Restart Time 120 and the unchanged IPv4/unicast tuple. TestRFC4724OpenOutsideTheRestartWindowClearsRestartState supplies cold-start and expired deadlines and asserts R clear with Time 120, so unconditional setting and unconditional omission both fail. The test-only wire view delegates to Peer.pluginCapabilitySnapshot; that production function captures declarations once and invokes restartFlagsFor before buildOpenFromSnapshot packs its captured capabilities. Supplementary TestSetRBitOnCapability and TestSetRBitTimeGatePattern pin the SetRBit edit and copy preservation; their copied time condition is not the production-window proof. The fixture adaptation and helper-comment correction preserve these inputs, tags and assertions. Discrimination freshness is checked separately by the main thread; this rejudgment makes no new execution claim.
